scope: Current factual package for Sleeping Giants and Giants' Foundry. It proposes integration only: no route timing, alloy choice, reward order, stop condition, owned inputs, quality, rate, profit, or readiness is asserted.

included: Access, travel options, inputs, 28-unit capacity, conversion and score formulae, moulds, stages/tools/heat, fixed reward formulas and prices, failure boundaries, repeatability, attention, and account observations.

Existing records are reuse targets, not duplicated authorities: utility-sleeping-giants-fixed-rewards, utility-giants-foundry-currency-and-unlocks, utility-stop-giants-foundry, economic-giants-foundry-commissions, action:sleeping-giants, action:giants-foundry, action:buy-double-ammo-mould, action:buy-full-smiths-uniform.
excluded: A final Ironman route, a preferred alloy/mould/reward order, expected commission count, XP/hour, coin/hour, net profit, player-owned state, or a universal Foundry stop condition.
Community tactics are preserved only as unscored strategy candidates.

requirements.commission: Select a mould; fill the 28-equivalent crucible with eligible metal; retrieve the moulded preform using a bucket of water or Ice gloves.

location_and_transport: The Foundry is in a cave beneath Giants' Plateau.
Documented approaches are Grouping/minigame teleport, amulet of glory to Al Kharid Palace, ring of dueling to Emir's Arena, gnome glider to Kar-Hewo, and the Lumbridge toll gate.
Their individual unlock/charge/readiness states and route time are deliberately not assumed.

entry_inputs.requirement: A poured sword needs exactly 28 eligible bar-equivalents. This package does not infer a player has the composition.
entry_inputs.boost_boundary: Temporary boosts may allow adding higher bars. The Wiki says one boost can fill two swords before a prior commission is completed; this does not assert an owned boost or prepared commission.

entry_inputs.requirement: Eligible anvil-Smithing equipment made from at least two bars gives one fewer bar-equivalent than its original recipe.
excluded_or_zero_value: Lovakite, blurite, and elemental bars/equipment cannot be used.
Dart tips, arrowtips, unfinished bolts, javelin tips, nails, knives, pickaxes, spears, hastae, halberds, swords, med helms, daggers, maces, axes, and crossbow limbs have zero value.
This package does not validate unlisted equipment as eligible.

entry_inputs.consumed: A water bucket is consumed when used; Ice gloves are reusable.
entry_inputs.requirement: One of those two routes is required to pick up the moulded preform.

reusable_setup.detail: Take a commission from Kovac, set one forte, blade, and tip mould, fill the crucible, then pour.
Storage preserves heat and progress across a leave/logout, but the commission timer continues.

metal_score.definition: Only the two most abundant eligible metals are scored; ties prefer higher tier. A third/lower-amount metal takes capacity but is disregarded in the formula.
metal_score.formula: V_total = floor((floor(10*V1)+floor(10*V2)+floor(V1*V2))/10), Vn=(10*tier_n*amount_n)/28; pure metal uses V2=0.
metal_score.temperature: Temperature ranges shrink linearly with metal score, to half full size at score 130.

mould_score.definition: Sum of selected forte/blade/tip contributions for the commission's two descriptors. It affects initial quality, not difficulty/sections.
mould_score.boost_boundary: A boosted level can set a mould but must remain active through pouring; after pouring, a dropped boost does not block completion.

quality.damage: Current Wiki: an incorrect tool or correct tool outside range removes 10 quality per damage event.
quality.sweet_spots: Successful sweet spot can regain lost quality and doubles next successful machine-use XP. Six/seven-section swords have three opportunities; all others have two, and a missed opportunity still counts.

refinement_stages.mechanic: Every fifth tick: 2% progress and -2.5% heat.
Every second tick: 1% progress and +1.5% heat.
Every second tick: 1% progress and -1.7% heat.

refinement_stages.temperature: Heat-preform is slower; Dunk-preform is faster; each accelerates over time until interrupted.
Cool-preform is slower; Quench-preform is faster; each accelerates over time until interrupted.

completion_or_reward_events.condition: 100% complete and not ruined, then hand to Kovac.

formulae_given_observed_final_quality_q.machine_xp: successful machine actions add their fixed XP; sweet spot doubles the next successful machine XP
formulae_given_observed_final_quality_q.other: 50% run energy restored; standard accounts receive coins in bank and Ultimate Ironmen in inventory.

completion_or_reward_events.boundary: q is not derived unless final quality and relevant execution details are observed.

failure_and_death.wrong_tool_or_temperature: Damages quality and can ruin the sword.
failure_and_death.zero_quality: The sword cannot be worked further and is handed to Kovac for fixed 30 Smithing XP and 60 coins regardless of inputs/moulds; no Reputation is asserted.
failure_and_death.materials: Submitted bars/equipment are consumed and no equivalent material is returned on a failed/ruined commission.
failure_and_death.combat_death: The Foundry is a non-instanced non-combat safe area; no combat death/reclaim/food requirement belongs to this loop.
failure_and_death.overwork: Clicking an already active machine, except a sweet spot, can make the next action give no progress; it does not justify inferred damage.

repeatability.cycle: After successful or failed hand-in, request another commission immediately. Descriptor, mould selection, input plan, quality, time, performance, output and shop readiness remain per-cycle observations.
repeatability.rng_boundary: There is no reward-pool roll for a hand-in or shop purchase. The activity-issued commission means mould score is unknown until commission and moulds are observed.

currencies.spend_behavior: Successful final quality q grants q Reputation; shop/mould prices are fixed, but balance and purchase readiness are observed only.
Coin reward is twice formula-derived hand-in XP after q is known. It is not a fixed profit because input acquisition/value is outside the formula.

utility: Permanent mould options that improve matching commission initial quality.
Two steel bars make eight cannonballs at a furnace in the time a normal ammo mould makes four from one bar.
rewards.repeatability: Permanent one-time ownership; no ownership assumed.

utility: Each worn piece: 20% chance to speed anvil action 5 to 4 ticks.
Each worn piece: 20% chance for bonus Foundry progress, 5% trip hammer and 10% grindstone/polishing wheel.
Gloves combine with Ice gloves into Smiths gloves (i).
rewards.repeatability: Permanent deterministic pieces; ownership/worn state observed only.

utility: Untradeable two-handed slash weapon requiring 60 Attack.
Passive adds 2 times NPC size to max hit, capped at NPC size 5.
rewards.reclaim_boundary: If later lost, Perdu reclaims it for 300,000 coins; that is separate from the Foundry purchase.
rewards.collection_log: One of nine Foundry collection-log items; no log state assumed.

rewards.repeatability: Repeatable; supply/use/boost state is not inferred.

utility: Consumable furnace effect: halves coal cost and doubles Smithing XP for an eligible coal-requiring bar.
At Blast Furnace doubles XP for eligible coal-requiring bars but does not further reduce coal; it can be banked there.
Opens to 30 noted ores from coal, iron, mithril, adamantite, and runite; composition is variable and independent of Mining level.
rewards.repeatability: Repeatable. No outcome, profit or input quantity is inferred.
rewards.collection_log: One of nine Foundry collection-log items; no log state assumed.

dependencies_and_bypasses.detail: 15 Smithing quest gate for permanent Foundry access.
Only for double ammo mould purchase, not Foundry play.
Reusable preform retrieval and combines with Smiths gloves; water bucket is the explicit alternative.
Consumes obtained equipment for lesser equivalent value without claiming any is owned.
Improves Foundry and anvil mechanics when worn.
Permanent quicker cannonball production after fixed gates.
Fixed 5,000-Reputation purchase; equipping separately needs observed 60 Attack.
Approach routes are alternatives, not ownership or timing claims.

logout_or_idle_constraints: Temperature-appropriate tool changes and progress tracking are required; mistakes damage quality.
Lava/waterfall temperature change accelerates with duration and natural cooling continues.
Storage preserves heat/progress across breaks/logout but not the timer.
No click cadence, AFK duration, hourly rate or player tolerance is asserted.
afk_and_attention.source_boundary: Official launch material described moderately click-intensive gameplay; live mechanics support active classification. Community 'chill' claims remain subjective strategy candidates.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Community guides commonly compare two-metal 14/14 and 9/19 alloy splits to trade quality, sections, cost, XP/hour, and Reputation/hour.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: Future scoring requires observed inventory, skill, moulds, competing demand, reward target, execution, and attention preference; no split/rate is selected.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Community Ironman discussion treats direct bars, scavenged equipment and shop-bought equipment as possible input paths and differs on mould/uniform/double-ammo reward order.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: World availability, costs, opportunity costs and owned supplies are account-specific.

community_strategy_observations.claim: A community calculator can compare player-entered banked resources across Foundry, Blast Furnace and anvil Smithing.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: Use only after independent formula review and observed account inputs.

state_boundaries: Do not infer quest/access, commission, moulds, composition, boost, retrieval item, inputs, storage, quality, mistakes, time, XP, coins, Reputation, rewards, reclaim state, or collection-log entries.
A successful hand-in is deterministic only after final quality q is observed. Basic eligibility is distinct from a validated 28-equivalent full crucible.
No equipment is treated as a beneficial input merely because it is metal/shop/drop equipment; eligibility and observed count need validation.
No failure probability or profit rate is modeled. Safe-area status excludes Foundry combat death only, not external travel risk.

facts.purpose: Consolidate 28-input, conversion, score, stages, storage, failure and formula boundaries into existing Foundry facts.
Normalize fixed prices/prerequisites/effects, consumable variability and Colossal blade reclaim distinction.
Normalize all 15 moulds with fixed level/cost and no purchase-order recommendation.

actions.required_change: Keep observation-only. Distinguish current loose >=2 equivalent preparation from a validated 28-equivalent completed-commission input plan; never auto-generate output.

actions.requirements: Access, observed Reputation, selected fixed cost, selected mould not owned, and Smithing/boost through pour boundary.
actions.transition: Exact Reputation subtraction and selected mould ownership only.

actions.requirements: Access plus exact observed Reputation and reward-specific gate.
actions.transition: Exact Reputation delta and item ownership only; consumables/packs need observed use/opening.

actions.requirements: Player reports commission, moulds, exact composition, final quality and outcome.
actions.transition: Compute only deterministic outputs from reported quality/success; retain unreported machine XP/time/errors/pack results.

account_observations.evidence: Reported interface value; never accumulated automatically
